newsitem.title: FRANCE: Michelin sees improving trend continuing.
newsitem.headline: Michelin sees improving trend continuing.

text.p: Tyre maker Michelin said moderate growth this year and lower costs should contribute to a continuation of the improving trend seen since 1994.

"The trends observed on the markets in the first half of 1996 should continue. Overall activity was sustained in the summer and should be at a satisfying level for the year, with moderate growth compared to the previous year," it said in its first-half results statement.
"On the other hand, the drop in costs will continue to play a favourable part," it said.
"Michelin thus confirms, for the full year 1996, the improvement it has been achieving since 1994," it said.
Its first-half net slipped to 1.35 billion francs from 1.51 billion after an exceptional 709 million franc charge for the restructuring of its Spanish subsidiary, Neumaticos Michelin SA.
But pre-tax pre-exceptional profit in the first half of 1996 jumped nearly 50 percent to 2.882 billion francs.
